scope: Numbered mathematical results of paper.tex under their explicit local and interface assumptions

results.label: prop:wellposed
results.assumptions: Normalized measurable causal kernels, measurable unit scores, exact own-law realization

results.label: lem:stopped
results.assumptions: Finite event alphabets, positive draw and accepted-observation probabilities, accepted-score identity, deterministic finite slot cap, activity determined from completed histories

results.label: thm:selection
results.assumptions: Actual growing exponential-weights recurrence, stochastic transitions, nonnegative estimates, supported predictable path, uniform code bound, explicit cumulative raw second-moment envelope, integrability and valid reference moments under the same experiment law

results.label: thm:native
results.assumptions: Nonempty comparator family, coherent own-law realizations, uniform directed certificates, code and rate shared across comparators

results.label: cor:native
results.assumptions: Positive horizons, native-transfer witnesses, horizon-dependent budgets uniform across comparators at each horizon, five normalized budget components tend to zero

results.label: thm:stability
results.assumptions: Finite complete-state kernels and common initial law and score, local TV contract, continuation range at perturbed states, local activity-cost domination and actual hard path budget for resource variant

results.label: thm:repair
results.assumptions: Reference endpoint identities, original directed witnesses, local resource sides uniformly for learner and comparator, no duplicated endpoint charge, stated asymptotic conditions

results.label: thm:local
results.assumptions: Finite normalized causal trial kernels, positive conditional validated retained-good hazard, per-task conditional quality, exact generation endpoint decomposition, local full-state deployment/resource contracts, identity inner deployment arrows, explicit remaining reference certificates, uniform comparator envelopes, positive horizons and local asymptotic conditions. Family statement allows horizon-dependent finite trial, episode and state domains, coupling laws, and reference identity domains on a fixed ambient measurable space and comparator index type. It uses the sum of learner and comparator resource envelopes divided by the positive horizon tending to zero.; validated completed-task scoring, explicit T versus T+1 clock, integrable intermediate endpoints, zero terminal resources

results.label: cor:instance
results.assumptions: Specified finite verified-template model. Fixed fair generic generator, deterministic guided mode, complete validator, k paid attempts, one output-only deployment slip with probability 1/4, native validation-based selection, own-history immediate-repair and fallback comparators. Family k=n+1, N=k^2, T=k+N. Interface bounds are proved from the model, not assumed. The conditional master is invoked through ModelMain.finite_controller_transfer. This is not a deployment-code or arbitrary-LLM guarantee.

results.label: cor:joint-budget
results.assumptions: Fixed causal design. Original native executions and own-law realizations. All original non-generation interfaces, with direct or independently proved deployment certificates. Normalized finite episode kernels, conditional retained-good hazard, local quality, exact generation endpoint identity, uniform comparator envelopes. Prepaid nonnegative cost envelopes and bounded initiated counts on every legal learner prefix. Comparator hard feasibility retained separately. Variable-domain asymptotic theorem derives native regret before applying aggregate remainder/delay, quality and exposure limits. Polynomial illustration has nonnegative integer exponents with positive sum, explicit ceiling quota and a positive quality root.

results.label: thm:benchmark
results.assumptions: Binary oblivious base tables, causal primitive phase Master, independent roundwise erasure, paid schedule, m and n positive, B >= 4m, 0 < q <= 1, q^3 T <= m B log B

results.label: cor:benchmark
results.assumptions: The benchmark bound, positive horizons and observation probabilities, normalized information and phase terms tend to zero

results.label: prop:imperfect-growth
results.assumptions: Specified finite type-local phases, frozen independent fair template generator, m independent fair validation probes, one-sided false acceptance, immutable retained cards, native latest-accepted batching with k paid attempts and N suffix tasks. Nonempty hard-feasible own-law comparator class with nonnegative common scores. Linear no-reflection comparison requires inclusion of the same-generator proactive comparator. Family E=k=m>=2, N=k^3. Full prefix resource cap Ek(m+2). All error and objective bounds derived from the actual law, not assumed. Not arbitrary LLM code, unknown phase schedules, cross-type coupling, or an anytime guarantee.
